items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: We've been on TV twice with Dave Galloway.

ctx.x: What about your brother Bernal? Did he read much or was he mostly... He didn't read at all.

He couldn't read at all. He tried it one time. And he was interfering with his fingering. He had such fast fingers he could play the Flight of the Bumblebee. All these hard numbers, sophisticated lady. Numbers like that he could play them. And that's where he features himself on these kind of pieces. See? He was working with him. So... When he tried to take up music he found out it was slowing up his fingering because the way the music was wrote was altogether different from the way he fingered the instrument and…
